EV-000012

Heilbronn problem, 11 points in a unit-area equilateral triangle · Heilbronn problems · status current

Definition

Maximum over 11 points in an equilateral triangle of area 1 of the minimum area of a triangle formed by three of them.

\max_{P}\min_{a,b,c\in P}\operatorname{area}(abc)

Domain: 11 points in a unit-area triangle. Normalisation: area. Direction: max.

Current value

0.0365 (bound)

Source: https://math.tejstead.com/heilbronn/triangle/ https://math.tejstead.com/heilbronn/triangle/ 2025-06
